Software platforms, developer tools, and operational systems.
Functional domain knowledge (e.g. Hedge Funds, KYC, NAV, Derivatives).
Complete list of candidate skills across all categories.
Complete chronological employment records with bullet points.
University, college, and higher education degree qualifications.
Major projects or strategic initiatives led by candidate.

semantic_frame.evidence_policy: Extract literal values from original sources; validate every field. Hints are not established values and empty hints do not mean absent.

completeness_check.interpretation: Every unmapped fragment retains exact source offsets and an explicit review reason; coverage is not proof of correct associations.

mapping_result.meaning: Source-bound output is available for inspection; this does not certify field accuracy.

standardization_metadata.duration_policy: Year precision: annual-resolution estimates from year-label differences, including current reference year for current roles; months are estimated years times 12, not known elapsed months. Year-label unions use common annual boundaries only for computation; no employment month is inferred. Month precision: elapsed calendar months (approximate). Day precision: completed calendar units. Aggregate unions use first-of-month boundaries for month-only dates; residual days use 365.2425/12 days per month, rounded to one decimal year.
